name: Chip
description: Chip: a lanky grocery bagger who can't pick up items or gold - he earns loot boxes by levelling (It's Called a Mortgage). Ja-Ja-Jimmy (stutter shout), Bagging (bag and throw enemies), Mega Cart (shopping-cart tank with a CIWS, first person), I Didn't Get You Anything? (a present-firing Christmas tree that might explode). Personal use.
